basic_details.job_title: PAU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Junior Lab/ Field Helper Posts
basic_details.short_information: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Junior Lab / Field Helper Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of Punjab Agricultural University (PAU). A total of 2 vacancies have been announced through the PAU Junior Lab / Field Helper Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 60 years

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for PAU Junior Lab / Field Helper Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://pau.edu.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Junior Lab / Field Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the PAU Junior Lab / Field Helper positions is 07 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Junior Lab / Field Helper post is Middle with Punjabi. Candidates must possess this qualification to be eligible for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Lab / Field Helper positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Junior Lab / Field Helper posts is between 18 years and 60 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Lab / Field Helper post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Lab / Field Helper position by Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the PAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for the PAU Junior Lab / Field Helper recruitment is Rs. 100/- for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Lab / Field Helper role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Lab / Field Helper post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 13,486/- to Rs. 14,286/- per month, with an additional Rs. 800/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the PAU Junior Lab / Field Helper recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Lab / Field Helper positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Lab / Field Helper positions involves an appearance before a Selection Committee. Candidates will be evaluated based on their performance during this committee interaction.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Junior Lab / Field Helper positions at Punjab Agricultural University are contractual appointments. This means the employment is for a fixed term as specified in the appointment letter.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) at https://pau.edu. Links are also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
